justification: Both surfaces carry purely abstract rectilinear carving — straight grooves forming rectangular/box-like cells, plus small round pits — rendered as schematic low relief or incision, which is a real but generic correspondence. The specific forms differ: A's central block shows a single bold nested-rectangle frame enclosing a raised ring (a circle-in-square motif) on a large architectural setting, while B shows a dense allover lattice or net of fine crossing lines with no enclosed disc and no comparable compositional focus.
